name: Resident Evil 4
notes: RE Engine DX12 → D3DMetal (Control class). This is the 2023 remake (2050650), not the 2005 original. Ray tracing is DXR via D3DMetal on M3/M4; DLSS cannot run on Apple Silicon. First run hitching is PSO translation. Pin CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk.
